t: Lightweight, bright floodlight with energy-efficient, high-performance LED chips delivers 120lm/W when switched on. Constructed from tough, corrosion-resistant die-cast aluminium housing with tempered glass. IP65 rated to prevent dust and water entry. Features innovative 'Fit & Tilt' multi-position ball joint for perfect directional focus for lighting up hard-to-reach areas. Swivel and tilt mounting arm allows easy installation and adjustment. Ideal for homes, offices, patios, driveways and parking areas. Includes 1m of cable.
